Collaboration models

Ways organisations work with us

  • Community partners — foundations, shelters and neighbourhood groups our members work alongside.
  • Grant supporters — organisations that fund a specific project or phase.
  • Materials & logistics partners — suppliers helping maker communities reach buyers.
  • Speakers & mentors — practitioners who share honest journeys at our events, like ENAC-TALK.

E Enactus ARSD

Enactus ARSD is the student-led Enactus chapter of Atma Ram Sanatan Dharma College, University of Delhi. We use entrepreneurial action to create livelihoods, dignity and well-being in the communities around our campus.
